decisions.summary: hamlet_burial knob: own_ground or village_ground, even odds (a guess), pin honored, nonsense refused
decisions.why: The GM's own fallback: a per-hamlet knob, some hamlets with their own graveyard and some without. The Summary and XVI now say the same (round 2 item 1).

decisions.summary: Size within 160's 750-2,450 sq ft full-body band by households, 1.4:1, labeled a guess
decisions.why: The plan, 540 and burial.py's docstring (round 2 item 3) now all label the band a GUESS that overstates an urn ground.

decisions.summary: Nearest clear seat from the middle of the houses, fall line breaking ties; 60 ft from houses and wells; 180's water set-backs; _fits
An own_ground hamlet with no clear seat within the reach draws no ground; the manifest records 'no seat'
decisions.why: Physically impossible to seat, and recorded rather than hidden. It stays legitimate only while it is the exception: if it fires on a pool hamlet, report it.

decisions.summary: The village cremation ground carries 530: seat knob, edge downstream, 120 ft, 30 px from water, off the shrine approach, within ~650 ft, six jizo; jizo off by default elsewhere
decisions.why: Matches 530 and the GM's ruling that villages have a cremation ground.

decisions.summary: Knob in hamletgen only; roll test covers both generators for no village features in a hamlet
decisions.why: Live hamlets are hamletgen's; the test enforces FR-003.
A separate liberty; the spec asks only that the feature say so.

decisions.why: The spec's edge case as a task. The Phases line now reads as T06 does (round 2 item 2).

decisions.summary: Pool hamlets that draw a ground re-roll; one settlement-review per moved map
160's hamlet clause and village band are 269's to rewrite to the knob
